name: Agorapulse
description:
Agorapulse is a social media management platform for marketing teams and agencies. This connector lets you work with your Agorapulse data directly in Claude using natural language.

What you can do:

Read your organizations, workspaces, and connected social profiles
Pull performance analytics: content insights, audience and community-management metrics, brand performance, and top-performing posts
Filter post performance by label
Draft posts and create calendar notes for later review

The connector authenticates through OAuth with your own Agorapulse account, so it only accesses data your account already has. It can create drafts but does not publish or post anything to your social accounts on its own.
Availability: the MCP connector requires an active Agorapulse subscription plus a compatible Claude plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agorapulse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agorapulse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.openmcp.agorapulse.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agorapulse MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agorapulse provides these MCP tools: create_note, create_simple_draft, get_audience_insights, get_brand_performance, get_community_management_insights, get_content_insights, get_labeled_post_performance, get_organizations, get_profiles, get_top_contents, get_workspaces, and search_notes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agorapulse?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agorapulse in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Agorapulse requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agorapulse is developed by Agorapulse. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
